main_measure.name: forecast-weighted mean excess 24-bar return of settlement-fall cases (forecast >= 2)

statistic.name: ordinary t of case excess returns

main_measure.threshold: confirm: weighted mean > 0 with t >= 2 (and supporting check passes); reject: weighted mean < 0 with t <= -2

supporting_check.name: mean excess return of forecast >= 10 cases minus forecast 2 to <10 cases

decided_by: A confirming weighted mean and t, but the supporting check failed or could not be measured: inconclusive.
reading: Settlement bars are those whose close (timestamp + 1h) is at 00:00 or 16:00 UTC; in each 24-bar grid cell counted from a window's first row the bar with the largest forecast is the case and is dropped if its 24-bar return leaves the window; the coin's mean 24-bar return is taken on the non-overlapping grid of all its windows; the supporting check is the difference of the two groups' unweighted mean excess returns (>=10 minus 2 to <10).
